decisions.response_path: Submit a formal response to the FDA acknowledging the warning letter and committing to the removal of the specified efficacy claims from the consumer product website.
decisions.distribution_status: Continue current distribution with immediate website updates.

commitments.detail: Remove the claims 'educes joint pain', 'prevents migraines', and 'boosts immunity' from all digital platforms.
Implement controls to ensure no unsubstantiated efficacy claims are published on the company website.
